bio.text: Melanie Stansbury represents New Mexico's 1st Congressional District and serves on the House Natural Resources and Oversight committees.
Her office says she was born and raised in New Mexico and previously represented the state in the New Mexico Legislature.

Before elected office she worked as a STEM educator and researcher on land and water issues, and as a staffer on the U.S. Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources and at the White House Office of Management and Budget.
